documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results And Declaration Of First Interim Dividend
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported a strong performance for Q4 and FY26, driven by a turning global agriculture and construction equipment cycle, strong execution of new business wins, and volume growth. The company successfully navigated supply chain challenges, including a facility fire in Ludhiana and West Asian geopolitical tensions, with robust insurance coverage and agile alternative arrangements. Management highlighted healthy order books, strong cash flows, a net-positive cash position, and a commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholder returns. Looking ahead, the company expects FY27 growth to be in line with FY26, supported by recovering end markets and a robust new business pipeline. Uniparts India reported its Q4FY26 and full year FY26 financial results, highlighting a 31% year-on-year revenue growth for the fourth quarter and 21% growth for the full year.

guidance.claim: The company expects growth in FY27 to be in line with the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: North American small agriculture is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

guidance.claim: For the full year FY26, revenues grew by 21% over FY25 against a guidance of mid teens growth.
guidance.quote: For the full year FY26, revenues grew by 21% over FY25 against a guidance of mid teens growth.

guidance.claim: Management remains committed to closing the full year with mid-teens revenue growth.
guidance.quote: We remain committed to closing the full year with the mid-teens growth, right, and this is consistent with the outlook as we have reiterated over the past three quarters.

guidance.claim: Management believes that FY27 should be a mid-teens growth year.
guidance.quote: Given that all segments or at least the construction and the small ag segments of the industry in the recovery phase and also the large ag seeing the worst behind us, at this point in time, we do believe that FY27 should be a mid-teens growth here.

demand_outlook.claim: The final quarter of FY26 provided further evidence that the global agriculture and construction equipment cycle is turning.
demand_outlook.quote: The final quarter of FY26 provided further evidence that the global agriculture and construction equipment cycle is turning.

demand_outlook.claim: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The European construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.
demand_outlook.quote: Specifically coming to Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs affirmed that quarter 4 of '26 represents a cyclical trough for large agricultural machinery.
demand_outlook.quote: Let me talk about the large agricultural machinery, continues to work through the current down cycle with leading OEMs affirming that quarter 4 of '26 represents a cyclical trough.

demand_outlook.claim: The aftermarket continues to be a stable contributor for Uniparts across North America and Europe.
demand_outlook.quote: We also have the aftermarket sector, and the aftermarket continues to be a stable contributor for Uniparts across North America and Europe.

demand_outlook.claim: In North America, construction equipment demand is expected to gradually strengthen through the year with the second half being better than the first.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers’ commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY2027 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market in North America is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY2027, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: In India, the tractor industry demand remains stable.
demand_outlook.quote: In India, the tractor industry demand remains stable.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs affirm that Q4 FY2026 represents the cyclical trough for large agriculture.
demand_outlook.quote: Large agriculture continues to work through the current down-cycle, with leading OEMs affirming that Q4 FY2026 represents the cyclical trough.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction activity in the US continues to be underpinned by infrastructure spending, investment in data centers, and energy transition projects.
demand_outlook.quote: The construction activity continues to be underpinned by infrastructure spending, investment in data centers, and energy transition projects.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer commentary for the US construction market suggests sequential improvement through the year with demand expected to strengthen in the second half of Year 2026.
demand_outlook.quote: Our customer commentary suggests sequential improvement through the year with demand expected to strengthen in the second half of Year 2026.

demand_outlook.claim: The European construction market is expected to remain stable with modest improvement through the current year '26.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the European construction market is expected to remain stable with modest improvement through current year '26.

demand_outlook.claim: In India, demand remains robust supported by favorable monsoons, healthy reservoir levels, GST reductions, and steady farmer sentiment.
demand_outlook.quote: In India, demand remains robust supported by favorable monsoons, healthy reservoir levels, GST reductions, and steady farmer sentiment.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agriculture is moving past the most challenging phase of the cycle, though recovery remains gradual and uneven across regions.
demand_outlook.quote: Based on current industry indications and the cycle progression, it is fair to say that large agriculture is moving past the most challenging phase of the cycle, although the recovery remains gradual and uneven across regions.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditures stood at INR12 crores for the fourth quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

capex_expansion.claim: CAPEX during the quarter was Rs.5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: CAPEX during the quarter was Rs.5 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% for quarter 4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Performance accounted for a INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.
margins_costs.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

margins_costs.claim: Management has stated consistently that a 20% EBITDA margin is sustainable over the cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle. And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.

margins_costs.claim: PAT includes a one-time exceptional cost of INR 34.19 Mn as the impact of the labour code.
margins_costs.quote: * PAT includes one time exceptional cost of INR 34.19 Mn as impact of labour code

margins_costs.claim: For Q3 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 21.5%.
margins_costs.quote: For Q3 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 21.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Trailing 12-month EPS post-Q3 results is Rs.28.80 after accounting for a Rs.3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code.
margins_costs.quote: In fact, the trailing 12-month EPS post-Q3 results is Rs.28.80 and this is after accounting for a Rs.3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

orders_capacity.claim: Order books strengthened sequentially compared to quarter 3 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Order books strengthened sequentially compared to the quarter 3 FY26, although the pace of recovery varied across geographies and industry segments.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month business wins exceeded INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% quarter-on-quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: So if I talk about the strategic outlook, our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Order books strengthened sequentially compared to Q3 FY26, although the pace of recovery varied across geographies and industry segments.
orders_capacity.quote: Order books strengthened sequentially compared to Q3 FY26, although the pace of recovery varied across geographies and industry segments.

orders_capacity.claim: New business awards pipeline remains strong at approximately Rs.200 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our new business awards pipeline remains to be strong at approximately Rs.200 crores, providing good visibility into future growth across segments and geographies.

orders_capacity.claim: Warehouse-led sales account for over 50% of revenues in the first nine months of FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Importantly, warehouse-led sales now account for over 50% of revenues in the first nine months of FY26, which is where we create the highest value of our customers through agility, resilience, and proximity.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to be net debt-free, with a net cash position of Rs.153 crores as on 31st December 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Cash flows remain strong and the company continues to be net debt-free, with a net cash position of Rs.153 crores as on 31st December 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The company announced a second interim dividend of Rs.7.
capital_allocation.quote: We have in fact also announced a dividend of Rs.7, a second interim yesterday.

risks_headwinds.claim: Toward the end of quarter 3, one of the facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incident in the finishing shop.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: The fire incident is fully covered under the insurance policy and the claim was filed during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The incident is fully covered under our insurance policy and the claim was filed during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariffs had some short-term impact on the aftermarket business.
risks_headwinds.quote: While tariffs had some short-term impact, the structural fundamentals of the aftermarket remain intact and diversification across regions and customer segments provide additional resilience.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fire occurred on 27th December 2025 in one of the factories in Ludhiana, impacting the surface finishing area of the plant.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, on the 27th of December 2025, we had a fire in one of our factories in Ludhiana, which impacted the surface finishing area of the plant.

management_commitments.claim: Rebuilding efforts are underway for the Ludhiana facility with an expectation to be online by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: So, Sunil, the efforts are underway to rebuild and to be online by the end of the year.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains committed to closing the full year with mid-teens growth.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to closing the full year with the mid-teens growth, right, and this is consistent with the outlook as we have reiterated over the past three quarters.
